# Telrhin

> Telrhin is a long-running tabletop RPG campaign setting centered on the continent of Numarha, within a cosmology of Three Worlds. The site is the home for its campaigns past and present — not a commercial product. It hosts worldbuilding content (encyclopedia entries, calendar/holidays, campaign session logs) for players and friends of the campaign.

Telrhin was conceived by two titanic beings, Hael and Syr, as the Great Dream — a vast magical reality now drifting toward a cosmic precipice called the Ehtre. If reality crosses into Wake, the slumbering Serpent Earth will rouse, shattering the dream into a sterile era of reason and destroying the gods. The gods, in turn, secretly feed on the "Dying Glow" released by mortal death to sustain their refuge, Atavis, orchestrating wars, plagues, and famine. In the mortal world of Prime, an early-renaissance civilization (the city-state of Larakan, the ruins of the fallen Destinite Empire, the Boradun's abandoned burrowdelfs) remains largely oblivious, while the Iron King wages the Red War in the south, the eldritch Ignum stir beneath the earth, and the demigod Talon the Severed Queen schemes to unmake reality.

The site is maintained by Christian Aldridge, a web developer and technology director for an environmental NGO, and former game designer (Hubris Games — Maelstrom Storytelling, Story Engine). Telrhin has evolved over roughly 40 years of campaigns, with significant contributions from Alex Oram, Ian Dickson, Seth Lindberg, Corbin Small, and Mike Steiner.

## Setting

- [About](https://www.telrhin.com/about): Site background, author bio, and a quick-reference kernel of setting facts (the three-world cosmology, the Kaladri elves' dark secrets, the Boradun dwarves' dark secrets, the Oneiros Dreamworld, the Golden Queen's wars)

## Blog

Session logs, worldbuilding notes, and campaign history, at `https://www.telrhin.com/blog/*`. Selected entries:

- [The Adventure Log Lives](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-adventure-log-lives): Campaign session log updates

- [The Central Story](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-central-story): The setting's core storyline
- [Three Worlds](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/three-worlds): The Three Worlds cosmology
- [Lost Gods](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/lost-gods): Divine lore
- [The Gods Want You to Die](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/the-gods-want-you-to-die): The gods' dependence on the "Dying Glow"
- [Severed Queen](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/severed-queen): Talon the Severed Queen
- [Divine Empress](https://www.telrhin.com/blog/divine-empress): Divine lore
